provenance.limitation: Attribution requires matching candidate source manifests, original baseline source manifests and replay runner hashes. Ablations score fresh inputs only and cannot attribute stateful update-rejection differences. The recorded source manifest defines the scope of source verification.
provenance.contextPolicy: Only identity, season, format, accepted play prefix, reconstructed current scores/clock and anchored available WP. No final boxscore, future result, odds, ranking or final records. Historical finalized-provider chronology remains a reconstruction limitation.
